These are the shop's standard operating procedures for the grooming shop app.
There is one manual for each role. Open the manual for your role.

::: {.manual-cards}

::: {.manual-card}
### [Groomer manual](groomer/index.qmd){.stretched-link}

For groomers. Signing in, finding a dog, checking it in, and recording the
haircut.
:::

::: {.manual-card}
### [Manager manual](manager/index.qmd){.stretched-link}

For managers. Opening Admin, verifying paperwork, second looks, and reviewing
changes.
:::

::: {.manual-card}
### [Systems manual](systems/index.qmd){.stretched-link}
